items.summary: Domain index Q-06 was a stale, unswept mirror of 13.11 Q-01, which D-04 (P-09) resolved on 2026-07-21. The sweep that rewrote the sibling mirrors (Q-08, Q-11, Q-13) to their resolutions missed Q-06, so the tree asserted the local-pickup settlement model was simultaneously open and decided. Rewrote Q-06 to the resolution (per-listing seller choice, both branches live, chain follows the money) and swept the five downstream locations inside the shard that still cited the dead 'domain Q-06' as a live dependency: 13.06.01's Q-04, its edge-case row and its relationship line; 13.06.02's local-pickup edge case and relationship line; 13.02.04's trigger-dependency line; 13.08.01's off-platform return row; and gear-marketplace-cx.md CX-09, which still called this 'the most consequential open question in the domain'. Every rewrite branch-qualifies rather than flattening — the off-platform hole is real, it is now bounded to the branch a seller elected, and it degrades to 15.01.03 D-01's manual handshake rather than to nothing (13.06.05 DT-11). No canonical file was touched; 13.11 is unchanged. The genuine residuals keep their own tracked rows with owners and deferral targets: 13.11 Q-04 (off-platform provenance presentation, Agent → /write-be-spec with domain 15), 13.11 Q-05 (settled-branch inspection window, pickup confirmation, tax situs, Agent → /write-be-spec), 13.06.05 Q-07 (cash-settled evidence tier, User → /create-prd-security), 13.06.01 Q-04 (mixed pickup/shipped cart — now unblocked and restated as a live product call, User → /create-prd).
